#Program 30
You may use as much memory as you want. 
You may call other functions you wish to; they must return something in all cases and terminate within 30 seconds. 
Your code will be compiled using Python 3.7. 
Note that there is no main function. The function f will be called for you automatically. 
In this function, if there is an error in your code, the error will be printed to the console. Please correct the error and resubmit the problem.
When submitting the problem, please submit the name of your function. 
You may submit the problem only once. 
The poster who wrote the correct code first will get the solution. 
If two posters write the correct code at the same time, the poster to post his/her code earlier will get the solution. 
If there is no correct code in a given time, the solution will be posted. 
If you want to try the problem again, you may post an answer to your own question.
If the problem requires a list of lists, you may use a list in a list or a 2-dimensional nested list. 
You may use the built-in functions of Python 3.7. 
You may use any third-party modules in your code. 
You may not change the input/output format. 

### Output:
The program should return the result of the operation.
